findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

The men’s bathroom in the facility is without paper towels by the hand sink at the time of this inspection. Paper towels were supplied during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

A large hole is observed in the frame of the back door. This is remaining from the previous routine inspection conducted two years ago. Repairs the hole prior to the next routine inspection and maintain the facility in good repair moving forward.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

The wall siding around the mop sink has been damaged and exposed wood/particle board. The PIC was shown and instructed to have repaired prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all areas subject to moisture are maintained sealed and smooth/easily cleanable.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

On arrival the mop is observed stored moist and with the head pooled up on the floor. The PIC was shown and instructed to store is so that the bristles are allowed to hang and air dry efficiently.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. 

The walls around the mop sink in the back are observed with exposed wood/particle board. Reseal the walls. Paint was suggested.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

Holes in the wall are observed in the back stock area and need to be repaired. Repair prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
No paper towels available in the women's restroom. CORRECTED-- Paper towels provided, and must always be available for proper handwashing.
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
--REPEAT #1: Soil residue observed in the bottoms of dairy coolers (both front and back of store).
--Significant frost build-up observed in the ice cream chest freezer. Clean non-food contact surfaces routinely to prevent soil accumulation.
4-601.11: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
Women's restroom door is not self-closing or tight-fitting. Adjust door and make repairs as needed so that the door is self-closing and tight-fitting.
6-202.14: Toilet rooms located on PREMISES shall be completely enclosed and provided with tightfitting and self-closing door.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Three holes observed in the drywall separating the restrooms from the storage area near the back door. Repair holes.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

Storage area is cluttered with backstock and shelving units to the point that is presumably difficult to maintain clean. Organize or discard unused items.
6-501.114: The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used.

Damp mop observed not stored properly. Prop mops so that they may airdry.
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.
